Note.CharmedLifeNaturalOne: Charmed Life: a natural 1 is rerolled. Use the reroll button on this card, without spending a Hero Point, and keep rerolling while it shows a 1.
Note.CharmedLifeFlatCheck: Charmed Life: roll a flat check (DC 11, or DC 6 from 10th level). On a success this save is one degree better.
Note.DeathlessUnconscious: Deathless: at 0 Hit Points you are Slowed 1 rather than Unconscious while your regeneration is active.
Note.DreadPresenceHealing: Dread Presence: if a creature frightened by your aura is reduced to 0 Hit Points, you regain half your level in Hit Points (your level from 10th), once per round (twice from 10th).
Note.DreadPresenceCriticalFailure: Dread Presence: the creature drops anything it is holding and cannot use reactions while in the aura.
Note.ElementalDamage: Elemental Embodiment: your element's damage ignores resistance (and immunity from 20th, for half damage). From 13th, creatures damaged by it suffer your element's rider.
Note.FlickerStepUnwilling: Flicker Step: you may bring one creature within your reach against its will: it attempts a Will save against the higher of your class DC and spell DC, and on a failure is teleported with you and Off-Guard until the end of your next turn.
Note.FarHandMove: Far Hand: once per round on a hit, move the creature up to 10 feet (15 from 15th) in any direction as a free action.
Note.LifelineRange: Lifeline: you may restore Hit Points at a range of 60 feet regardless of the spell's normal range.
Note.LivingShadowStealth: Living Shadow: in dim light or darkness you may Hide as a free action once per round, and you may Hide and Sneak without cover or concealment. From 10th your movement makes no sound and you cannot be detected by hearing, scent, tremorsense or lifesense.
Note.OverreactionReactions: Overreaction: you have extra reactions this turn (two at 1st, three at 10th, four at 15th, plus Borrowed Time's). You may use them while Off-Guard, Prone or Grabbed, and Reactive Strike triggers on any spell cast within reach.
Note.OverwhelmArea: Overwhelm: exclude up to your spellcasting attribute modifier creatures from the area, and convert a burst to a cone or line of equivalent size or the reverse. From 10th the area is doubled.
Note.PeerlessCrafter: Peerless Crafter: you may Craft any item up to your level + 2. From 5th: no workshop needed, any raw materials of equal or greater value substitute, crafting takes 1 day at 75% of the Price. From 10th: Craft during a 10-minute rest, salvage at 75%, and transfer or swap runes at no cost.
Note.RenewedFocusDiscount: Renewed Focus: once per round, this focus spell costs 1 fewer action (a 1-action spell becomes a free action). From 15th, once per round, it costs no Focus Points.
Note.RuinousBlowsHit: Ruinous Blows: apply Ruinous Blows: AC Penalty to the target (-1 at 1st, -2 from 5th, -3 from 15th) until the end of your next turn.
Note.RuinousBlowsCritical: Ruinous Blows: the target's resistances are halved against all damage until the end of your next turn, and once per round you may attempt to counteract one magical effect on it (counteract rank half your level rounded up, check equal to your attack modifier with this weapon).
Note.RuinousBlowsDamage: Ruinous Blows: this Strike ignores hardness and resistance up to your level, deals double damage to an object's Hit Points from 5th, and deals half damage through immunity from 15th.
Note.SoulboundReactions: Soulbound Arsenal: the weapon has its own reaction each round (two from 15th) for Bonded Strike, which neither counts toward nor against your multiple attack penalty.
Note.SovereignMindIncapacitation: Sovereign Mind: you are immune to incapacitation effects that call for a Will save.
Note.SpellVolleyCost: Spell Volley: a single-target attack-trait spell or cantrip costs 1 action; from 15th, any attack-trait spell does.
Note.TrailBreakerAutoSuccess: Trail Breaker: you automatically succeed at this check if its DC is your level or lower.
Note.UnbrokenTempoCritical: Unbroken Tempo: once per round, on a critical hit you may immediately Strike the same target with the same weapon as a free action.
Note.UnerringShot: Unerring Shot: ignore the concealment flat check and cover short of greater cover (greater cover too from 10th). A second or later hit on the same creature this round ignores its resistances. Spell range increments are doubled. From 10th you may target a creature you sense but cannot see without a flat check; from 15th this attack cannot be blocked, redirected or targeted by reactions.
Note.Warmage: Warmage: a Spellstrike critical hit makes the delivered spell critical, and Spellstrike does not count against your multiple attack penalty. From 20th a Spellstrike may deliver two spells.
Note.AbundantVitalityMedicine: Abundant Vitality: add +4 Trained, +8 Expert, +12 Master, +16 Legendary or +20 Mythic (the higher of your spellcasting and Medicine ranks) to the Hit Points restored.
Note.AbundantVitalityTargets: Abundant Vitality: a spell targeting one willing creature other than yourself may target a second (and from 5th, you as well); from 15th, any number of willing creatures. From 10th beneficial spells of 1 minute or less last twice as long, Sustain is a free action once per round, and compositions last 1 minute.
Note.AegisBlock: Tireless Aegis: once per turn you may Shield Block without spending a reaction. From 15th the attacker takes damage equal to what the Aegis absorbed.
Note.BattleMender: Battle Mender: Battle Medicine and First Aid reach 30 feet, Treat Wounds takes 1 minute. From 10th, also reduce the target's Wounded value by 1 and remove one condition of your choice.

ModuleEnabled.Name: Enable Dual Class
ModuleEnabled.Hint: Turn on the Dual-Class Characters variant rule. Every character then needs two classes: players cannot level one past 1st until it has both, though you can as GM.

TripleClass.Name: Allow a Third Class
TripleClass.Hint: Let every character take a third class, treated exactly like the second: the best of the three proficiencies, the highest Hit Points, the largest skill count rather than the sum, and a class feat ladder each. Not a published variant rule. To allow it for particular characters instead, leave this off and use Third Class Permissions.

ThirdClassPermissions.Name: Third Class Permissions
ThirdClassPermissions.Hint: Allow a third class to particular characters, for a world that is otherwise dual class. Ignored while Allow a Third Class is on, which already covers everyone.
ThirdClassPermissions.Label: Choose Characters
ThirdClassPermissions.Title: Third Class Permissions
ThirdClassPermissions.None: This world has no characters yet.
ThirdClassPermissions.TableHint: Ticked characters may take a third class. Unticking one does not remove a class they already have.

SkillCounter.Name: Show the Skill Proficiencies Panel
SkillCounter.Hint: Count proficiency points at the top of a character's Proficiencies tab: what the build gives, what has been spent, any unspent skill increases, and any rank too high for the character's level. Works on single-class characters and does not need Dual Class switched on.

AncestryParagon.Name: Enable Ancestry Paragon
AncestryParagon.Hint: Every character gains a second ancestry feat at 1st level and another at each odd level thereafter, eleven in total. Independent of Dual Class. Skipped if another module already provides these slots.

FreeArchetype.Name: Enable Free Archetype
FreeArchetype.Hint: Turns on the Pathfinder 2e system's own Free Archetype variant, which adds an archetype feat ladder at every even level. The same as ticking it in the system's Variant Rules settings; it is here so the three variant rules Ascendant is played with sit together.

Sheet.PickHint: The class keeps its own feat ladder, class DC and key attribute boost. Its features are granted straight away, so expect the usual choice prompts.
Sheet.NoClassesFound: No other class items were found in this world or its compendia.
Sheet.PrimaryIs: Primary class: {class}. The primary sets the character's key attribute and main class DC.
Sheet.Removed: Removed {class} and the features it granted.

Mismatch.Warning: {feat} belongs to {belongs} but was placed in the {placed} feat slots. It still counts; move it if that was not intended.

Skills.Redirected: redirected, from a second source training a skill you already had
Skills.LoreNote: Becoming trained in a Lore is not counted, since a background, a feat or the GM can hand one out. Ranks above trained are counted, because a skill increase is what buys them.
Skills.AllTrained: {actual} of {total} skills trained - all of them
Skills.AllTrainedWhy: Something on this character trains every skill, so the class skill picks have nothing left to spend on and there is no count worth showing.
Skills.HowCounted: Trained 1 · Expert 2 · Master 3 · Legendary 4. A source is worth the ranks it adds, and a skill increase is worth one.
Skills.ExtraIncreases: extra skill increases from feats and features

Coexist.KeptFirstClass: {actor} kept {class} as its first class. Remove a class from the items list if you meant to replace it rather than add one.
Coexist.UnarmedManyClasses: {actor} already has {count} classes, so adding another replaces them. This module only handles two.
Coexist.AdoptedBatch: {actor} was created with several classes: {primary} is the first class, with {classes} recorded as extra.

PlannerSlots.Refiled: {feat} moved to the {class} class feat slot for level {level}.

LevelGate.Blocked: Add the missing class before levelling past 1st: its 1st-level features and proficiencies belong to the character from the start.
LevelGate.GmAllowed: Levelling anyway because you are the GM.
